72387.subject: Data Processing
72387.question_text:
(a) State four benefits of Internet in Education.
(b) Explain the following types of maintenance in computing: (i) corrective; (ii) adaptive; (iii) preventive.
72387.explanation:
(a) Benefits of Internet in Education: 

  • It provides opportunities for collaboration (Collab) teachers/students/ schools.
  • It is employed for carrying out research 
  • It Supports Virtual laboratory 
  • It is used for communication 
  • It provides opportunities for continuous education
  • It supports personalized learning for students.
  • -|bi) Safety rules in computer laboratory - It is used as Information sharing tools - It provides opportunity for continu-

(b) Types of Maintenance

(i) Corrective maintenance: is a task performed to identify, isolate, and rectify a fault so that the failed equipment or system can be restored to an operational condition. OR Any maintenance performed to return equipment or system to a proper working condition.
 
(ii) Adaptive maintenance: is the modification of an existing system to meet/suit new/changing environment/technological development. 

(iii) Preventive maintenance: is a form of maintenance that is regularly performed on a system to avoid breakdown or failure. OR it is a maintenance performed while the equipment is still working so that it does not break down unexpectedly.

72390.subject: Data Processing

72398.subject: Data Processing
72398.question_text:
The Local Area Network (LAN) in a certain school is connected to the internet. The school also has a management system (MIS) which is used to enroll staff and students in the school. The system requires that users be authenticated before access is granted. Students are also allowed to use computers in the network during their leisure time.

a(i) State two problems associated with an uncontrolled access to the internet by the students
(ii) How can the problems stated in 4a(i) be prevented?
(b) Give one reason for users' authentication before access to the system is granted
(c) To use the mIS, a staff is expected to log in using a registered username and password.
Table below shows login activities and the login steps to the to the MIS. Specify te correct order or steps in the login process in column Y using the letter A-E attached to the login activities in column X.
 

X: Login Activity Y: Login Step
A: system authenticates username and password (i)
B: click on login (ii)
C: enter password (iii)
D: (access granted/denied) (iv)
E: enter username (v)
72398.explanation:
a(i) Problems Associated with an uncontrolled access to the Internet by students

  • Chatting during classes / Using social media.
  • Virus download.
  • Purchasing items online.
  • Playing games to the detriment of their studies/during classes
  • Watching videos/movies.
  • Playing music 

(ii) Ways of solving the problems stated in 4a(i) 

  • Use of web nannies
  • Use of virus detection software
  • Supervised access by a teacher/technologist/adult
  • Use of filtering software/Content filtering software to block access to inappropriate or harmful websites.
  • Parental controls: Utilize parental control settings available in operating systems, browsers, and routers to Safe search settings: Enable safe search settings in search engines to filter out explicit content.
  • Implementing firewalls / Network - Level Firewalls / Application-Level Firewalls: Use firewalls that specifically manage the traffic of individual applications and services.
  • Time Management Tools - Screen Time Limits - Scheduled Access - Secure Networks - Wi-Fi Security.
  • VPNs (Virtual Private Networks) and Encrypted connections.
  • Monitoring software.
  • Activity monitors.
  • Alerts and Notifications.
  • Digital Literacy Education.
  • Online safety training.
  • Critical thinking Skills.
  • Promoting responsible use.
  • Internet etiquette.
  • Encourage balanced use.
  • Establishing clear policies/acceptable use policies.
  • Penalties/Consequences for misuse.
  • Parental and educator involvement.
  • Environmental and supportive strategies.
  • Encouraging healthy online habits.
  • Collaborative approaches.
  • Promote alternative activities.
  • Regular review and adaptation.
  • Stay updated on trends and risks. 
  • Cybersecurity Updates: Keep abreast of the latest cybersecurity threats and protective measures.
  • Evolving Technologies: Adapt strategies as new technologies and digital platforms emerge.
  • Regular Policy Review.
  • Explore New Solutions that can enhance internet safety and control.

(b) Reason for user authentication be- fore access to the system is granted

  • prevent impersonation
  • prevent unauthorized access
  • ensure only registered users have access 
  • ensure data integrity/ safety
  • Support remote and mobile access

(c) Steps in using the MIS

 

X: Login Activity

Y: Login Step
A: system authenticates username and password (i) E
B: click on login (ii) C
C: enter password (iii) B
D: (access granted/denied) (iv) B

72403.subject: Data Processing
72403.question_text:
Highlight the steps to perform the following
(a) creating a new table
(b) generating a query
(c) creating a splít form
(d) printing a report
72403.explanation:
(a) Steps in creating a new table

  • Click on File
  • Select New
  • Slet blank desktop database
  • Type the name for the new database in the filename box

OR

  • Click on Create on the menu bar
  • Select Table
  • Click on Save As on the File menu
  • Type the Table name

(b) Steps in generating a query

  • Click on Create on the menu bar
  • Select Query Wizard
  • Select Simple Query from option and click on Ok
  • Select the Table(s) that contains the required fields/add required fields
  • Add the required fields to the selected fields section
  • Click on Next
  • Choose whether you went to open the query in datasheet view or modify the query in design view, click on Finish button.

(c) Steps in creating a Split Form

  • Select the Table or Query that contains the data.
  • Click on Create tab
  • Click on more forms 
  • Click on Split Form
  • Select the Table/Query

(d) Steps in printing a report

  • Select the report to be printed from the Navigation Pane/Open the report to be printed
  • Click on File
  • Click on Prin/CTRL +P, select the printer, and set other properties
  • On the Print dialog box, Click on Ok to print
  • Bight click on the report to be printed on the Navigation Pane
